🌸 Seasonal Guide: When to Visit the Greek Islands
days.description: Hottest (30–35°C), most crowded, and most expensive. Ferries run the most frequently. Nightlife peaks — Mykonos and Santorini are at their liveliest. Book everything 2–3 months ahead. Meltemi winds can be strong (good for windsurfers, rough for ferry-sensitive stomachs).
